plan.title: bug(resolution): defaultEngineProbe reports engine unreachable on Windows despite global npm install

narratives.Description: Windows npm global bins are .cmd shims; defaultEngineProbe uses bare execFileSync without shell/PATHEXT and reports unreachable even when directive/deft work interactively. Doctor Resolution and update self-heal ladder both consume this false-negative and block or print global: absent.
narratives.Overview: On Windows, execFileSync('directive'|'deft') without shell/PATHEXT fails on npm global .cmd shims, so classify/defaultEngineProbe returns unreachable even when the global engine works interactively. Fix probe resolution; cover with regression test.
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows consumer with a global npm engine, I want doctor and update to detect that engine, so that they do not block on a false unreachable diagnosis.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Fix probeEngineVersion/defaultEngineProbe in packages/core/src/resolution/classify.ts for Windows PATH/.cmd resolution and prefer in-process identity when already inside the CLI.
2. Add regression coverage in packages/core/src/resolution/classify.test.ts for the Windows npm-shim case.
3. Run vitest on classify tests; add CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry. Closes #2606.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. defaultEngineProbe reports reachable+version when global directive/deft is on PATH via npm .cmd
2. doctor Resolution is not blocked solely by the false unreachable probe
3. update ladder does not print global: absent when the engine is present
4. Tests pass; CHANGELOG updated

narrative.Acceptance: Given win32 with npm global .cmd shims for directive/deft on PATH, when defaultEngineProbe runs, then reachable is true and engineVersion parses from the banner.

items.title: In-process identity preferred when already in CLI

narrative.Acceptance: Given doctor/update already executing inside @deftai/directive, when classify needs engine version, then it prefers in-process identity over a failing bare-name subprocess probe.

items.title: Regression test for Windows npm-shim probe

narrative.Acceptance: Given classify.test.ts, when the suite runs, then it covers the Windows shim / shell:true (or equivalent) resolution path so Linux CI cannot green-wash the bug.

expected_outputs: doctor/update no longer false-block on probe
